name: aws_ecs_cluster
description: Manages an ECS (Elastic Container Service) cluster. ECS is a fully managed container orchestration service. Combined with Fargate, it allows you to run containers without managing servers. ECS is the preferred choice for simpler monolithic applications or when you want managed container infrastructure without Kubernetes complexity.
use_cases: Run containerized applications without managing EC2 instances (Fargate)
Applications requiring simpler operational model than Kubernetes

optional.name: capacity_providers
optional.description: List of capacity providers associated with the cluster. Deprecated in favor of the capacity_providers argument on the cluster resource itself.

optional.name: configuration
optional.description: Configuration block for the ECS cluster. Contains execute_command_configuration.

optional.name: service_connect_defaults
optional.description: Default namespace for ECS Service Connect.

optional.name: setting
optional.description: Configuration block for cluster settings. Used to enable Container Insights.

optional.name: tags
optional.description: Map of tags to assign to the resource.

best_practices: Use Fargate launch type to avoid managing EC2 instances
Enable Container Insights for monitoring and troubleshooting
Use FARGATE_SPOT for non-critical workloads to reduce costs (up to 70% savings)
Always configure awslogs log driver for container logs to CloudWatch
Use separate IAM roles for task execution and task permissions
Place ECS tasks in private subnets with ALB in public subnets
Use ECS Service Auto Scaling based on CPU/memory metrics
Pin container image tags — never use 'latest' in production
security_notes: Never use host network mode for Fargate tasks — use awsvpc mode
ECS Exec requires explicit enablement — restrict IAM permissions for it
Use KMS encryption for ECS Exec audit logging
Scan ECR images for vulnerabilities before deployment
Use separate task execution role and task role with least-privilege policies

common_errors.fix: Check CloudWatch logs for container output. Verify container image, environment variables, and secrets

common_errors.error: ECS tasks cannot pull image from ECR
common_errors.fix: Check task execution role has AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly. Verify VPC endpoints for ECR or NAT gateway
